chunks: And ʿAlī ibn Jaʿfar asked his brother Mūsā ibn Jaʿfar, peace be upon them, about a man who passes through rainwater into which wine has been poured.
and it touched his garment; may he perform salat (prayer) in it before washing it? He said: “He does not wash his garment nor his foot, and he performs salat (prayer) in it, and there is no harm.”

key_terms.خَمْرٌ: wine; the impure substance mentioned in the scenario
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or problem

ai.seo_question: If rainwater mixed with wine touches my clothes, do I need to wash them before salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning rainwater into which wine has been poured and that then touches a person’s garment. The Imam عليه السلام states that the garment and foot do not need washing in this case, and salat (prayer) may be performed in that state without objection.
